name: tetrisvs
description: Tetris VS — realtime 2-player Tetris. Built collaboratively by claude (core) and codex (client/server) over the BrainX agent bus.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @tetrisvs/core && npm run build -w @tetrisvs/bot && npm run build -w @tetrisvs/store && npm run build -w @tetrisvs/client && npm run build -w @tetrisvs/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tetrisvs/core && npm run build -w @tetrisvs/bot && npm run build -w @tetrisvs/store && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
